data.name: Shatrudhan
data.gender_notes: Shatrudhan is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Shatru-dhana' meaning 'having a hundred weapons'. This name is often given to boys born into warrior families or those destined to defend their community. It symbolizes strength, courage, and loyalty. The name Shatrudhan carries the meaning “Having 100 weapons” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit. Parents who choose Shatrudhan usually hope their child will grow to embody having 100 weapons and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for those who carry the burden of protecting their loved ones and community, and are endowed with the strength, courage, and wisdom to do so.
data.etymology: Shatrudhan belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Having 100 weapons.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Shatrudhan total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

historical_references.reference: Shatrudhan is mentioned in the Mahabharata as a king of the Vangas, a region roughly corresponding to present-day Bengal, India. He is also known as Sahasrarjit or 'the one with a thousand eyes', and is considered to be an incarnation of the god Shiva. Shatrudhan is a formidable warrior and is a key ally of the Pandava brothers during their struggle against their cousins, the Kauravas.

'Shatrudhana' is the name of a king during medieval Bengal, ruling from the Sena Dynasty in the 12th century CE. He is known for his military prowess and his capital was located in the area of present-day Kolkata.

modern_usage.modern_context: In Hindu mythology, Shatrudhan is known as the god of seventeen treasures. He is often depicted as a guardian of wealth and a powerful warrior. Shatrudhan's name means 'having seventeen enemies' in Sanskrit. In modern contexts, his name has been seen on various platforms. In role-playing games such as Dungeons & Dragons and tabletop RPGs, players can create characters based on Shatrudhan's legend and attributes. Additionally, Shatrudhan's story has made its way into popular culture, with adaptations in various media such as comics, novels, and films. The general trend is the continued interest and exploration of Hindu mythology and Indian folklore in contemporary society.
